description: Generate and schedule a BATCH of persona videos in one call (2-12), cheaper than one by one: for every 6 videos with the persona face in the batch, the cheapest one is free (its tokens are credited back right after creation). Faceless videos can be in the batch but pay full price, do not count toward the 6 and are never free. Each video takes the same fields as generate_persona_video and is created and dispatched right away, one after the other, so the batch renders together. All videos must be created within 10 minutes of the first. Cancelling a video of a discounted batch (cancel_schedule) gives back the discount the batch no longer earns: it is withheld from that video's refund. If a video fails validation or creation, the videos before it stay created and discounted; fix the error and call again with the same batchKey and the same videos in the same order — created videos replay without a new charge. After creation, wait for every taskId with wait_for_video_tasks.

batchKey.description: A name for this batch, unique per batch (e.g. "launch-week-1"). Reuse it with the same videos in the same order to retry: created videos replay instead of being charged again.

videos.description: The videos, each with the same fields as generate_persona_video (no idempotencyKey, experiment or recipe). Up to 12.

blueskyAccountIds.description: Bluesky DIDs (the did field from list_social_accounts).

description.description: Video description: the publish copy sent to the web route (one call is one video). Required — there is no fallback to the title.

facebookAccountIds.description: Facebook Page IDs (the providerAccountId field from list_social_accounts).

fanvueAccountIds.description: Fanvue account IDs (the providerAccountId field from list_social_accounts).

instagramAccountIds.description: Instagram account IDs (the igUserId field from list_social_accounts).

language.description: Spoken language code — English only for now, e.g. en-US.

linkedinAccountIds.description: LinkedIn account IDs (the providerAccountId field from list_social_accounts).

mode.description: Publish mode: 'scheduled' (default) slots the video across startAt + times; 'asap' publishes it the moment generation finishes, with no scheduled time — do not set startAt or times.

options.description: Generation options applied to this video.

audioUrl.description: Public URL of custom audio for the videos (overrides the persona voice).

imageId.description: Library image ID to use for every video (overrides the deterministic per-video selection; see list_persona_images).

language.description: Spoken language code — English only for now, e.g. en-US. Overrides the persona when one is given.

musicMood.description: Background-music mood for the video: a mood from the engine BGM catalog, or "none" for explicit no music. Omitted lets the engine pick the first catalogued mood; an unknown mood is rejected with a 400 naming the valid moods. Works with faceless videos too.

niche.description: Content niche. Overrides the persona when one is given.

paragraphNumber.description: Paragraph count (1-10). Overrides the persona when one is given.

videoAspect.description: Frame shape. Overrides the persona when one is given; a post without a persona defaults to 9:16.

videoLayout.description: How the persona hook is composed with the video material (the agent images). Overrides the persona when one is given; a post without a persona defaults to "standard". Same render cost either way.

videoType.description: The one video mode: full_lipsync = the whole video is the persona talking (requires a persona with a photo; 8 tokens at face quality ok, 15 at very_good); hook_lipsync = lip sync on the hook only, agent images after (requires a persona with a photo; 2 tokens ok, 3 very_good); faceless = agent images only, no face (persona optional — with one, its voice and niche still apply; 1 token). Required: the mode decides the render path and the price.

voiceId.description: Voice ID override: id or label from list_voices. Never type a provider prefix.

webhookUrl.description: Callback URL the server POSTs to when each video reaches a terminal state (completed/failed).

personaId.description: The persona to generate the video with. Omit for a faceless post with no persona: in that case set options.videoType to 'faceless' and options.voiceId (or options.audioUrl).

pinterestAccountIds.description: Pinterest account IDs (the providerAccountId field from list_social_accounts).

pinterestBoardId.description: Pinterest only: the board to publish the pin to (the id from list_pinterest_boards). Required when pinterest is selected.

rumbleAccountIds.description: Rumble channel IDs (the providerAccountId field from list_social_accounts).

segments.description: The complete script as segments: first hook, then body segments, last CTA. Total 60-200 words, body at least 30, CTA 5-20, hook 15-40 words before TTS. The hook must end with terminal punctuation. No LLM expands this script.

kind.description: Segment role: hook first, body in the middle, CTA last. Exactly one hook and one CTA.

media.description: Photos for this segment, as a list. Each item is exactly one of mediaId (from upload_media) or url (a public image URL). One image per ~3s of speech (about 8 words), e.g. a 60s video needs about 20 images; split them across segments (at most 30). Full lip sync allows at most 6 images in total. Each photo is shown while its share of the segment is spoken: full frame on faceless videos, or a framed panel (about 38% of the frame) at the bottom where the persona face is on screen, so the face still shows. Optional overlay on an item: an info card (title, subtitle, badge), e.g. a place name, address and price; a caption spoken while a panel shows is placed above it, never on the photo.

badge.description: Short highlight such as a price or a year, shown as a pill above the title.

subtitle.description: Address or area, shown under the title.

title.description: The real place name, shown large on the card.

text.description: Spoken text only: no placeholders, links, markdown, emoji or stage directions.

startAt.description: When the publish slot may start: ISO datetime. Required unless mode is 'asap'. The slot must be 3h-30d ahead.

threadsAccountIds.description: Threads account IDs (the providerAccountId field from list_social_accounts).

threespeakAccountIds.description: 3Speak Hive usernames (the providerAccountId field from list_social_accounts).

times.description: Daily publish times in HH:MM 24-hour format. Required unless mode is 'asap'.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for a naive startAt and the HH:MM times, e.g. "Europe/Lisbon". Defaults to UTC.

title.description: Video title: the slot label sent to the web route (one call is one video).

youtubeAccountIds.description: YouTube channel IDs (the channelId field from list_social_accounts).

name: generate_persona_video_batch
